Your first steps with Clara

This page takes you from a new workspace to your first draft. You need access to a Clara workspace. If you're new here, request early access.

Where to find it: sidebar → Products, Brand & knowledge, Plays

Bring one product into focus

  1. Open Products and choose the product you're working on.
  2. Write a clear description: what it does, who uses it, and the problem it helps them solve.

Keep your first task focused on one product and one audience.

Give Clara something to work from

  1. Open Brand & knowledge.
  2. Add your voice, audience and writing guidelines.
  3. Bring in relevant product sources. A current overview and a specific release note make a good start.

See Give Clara your context for the details.

Make a first draft

  1. Open Plays and choose a format, such as a LinkedIn post or blog article.
  2. Give Clara a short brief about what changed and why it matters.

You can also start a conversation through New chat. For example:

Write a LinkedIn post about our new shared project view. Speak to small product teams. Explain how it helps them see the next step, using the attached release notes.

Meet Agents and Workflows

After your first draft, open Agents for recurring marketing roles and Workflows for the jobs behind them. Choose how independently they run in Settings → Autonomy. See Build your marketing team.

Review before you share

Open the resulting work and check its claims against your sources. Refine the wording. A finished generation is a draft to assess. Check the destination and any connected publishing action before you approve it.
